prompt: What does @Inherited mean on an annotation declaration?
choices: The annotation is shared between all instances of a class
If a class has this annotation, its subclasses automatically inherit it
The annotation can be used on interfaces
The annotation is visible to sub-packages
explanation: @Inherited (java.lang.annotation) makes a class-level annotation automatically inherited by subclasses. Example: @Retention(RUNTIME) @Inherited @interface Audited {} — if Dog has @Audited, Poodle extends Dog also has it accessible via getAnnotation(Audited.class). @Inherited only works on class annotations, not methods or fields.
